slides.title: Brakes India can progress from demo to production.

Confirm the policy and environment assumptions in Week 1.

slides.title: The included warranty covers defects for 90 days.
slides.notes: 90 calendar days from production go-live, included in the base estimate. The first two weeks provide closer release support within the same warranty period. Correct reproducible defects against the accepted scope and approved calculation results. The six-person-day allowance is an internal cost provision, not a client hour cap or a separate charge for covered defects. New features, changed business policies requiring new logic, third-party outages and client-caused infrastructure changes are outside defect warranty.

slides.title: Gross fixes targets before balancing.
slides.notes: The URD requires monthly Gross as input, with Inclusion and Exclusion each equal to half of Gross. Calculate fixed Inclusion values, then Exclusion values, then Special Allowance and HRA. No circular formulas. Employer PF, NPS and Superannuation already sit within Gross. Unequal totals or negative balancing values prevent output; HRA has no Basic-based cap.
slides.text:
4. Key Features and Functionalities | Appendix
Gross fixes targets before balancing.

URD
17

Inclusion = Exclusion = Gross/2
Special Allowance = Gross/2 − Basic − Professional Allowance
HRA (uncapped) = Gross/2 − Conveyance − PF − NPS − Superannuation

slides.title: PF and NPS follow the supplied URD rules.
slides.notes: Apply PF tiers in order. Half-Inclusion means fifty percent of Inclusion wages, not half of Basic. All PF amounts are INR. NPS is optional: when selected, fourteen percent of Basic for New Regime or ten percent for Old Regime; otherwise zero. Gratuity follows 4.81% of Inclusion and Employer ESI 3.25% subject to the approved wage basis/limit. Keep rates and ceilings configurable.
